text:
jamie: Quick pass — top toolbar (primary action + filter pill) has two issues: 1) action pill contrast ~2.8:1 on dark theme, 2) focus ring disappears when keyboard-tabbing from search -> actions. Can someone validate and propose fix?

elaine: I can repro. On Mac/Chrome with high-contrast mode off the focus outline is clipped by the overflow:hidden on .toolbar-group. Happens for keyboard only, mouse focus fine. :eyes:

kevin: Looks like the pill uses `box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0)` on focus. Suggest switching to `outline: 3px solid var(--focus)` and ensure `outline-offset: 2px`.

maria: Also noticed screen reader doesn't announce the filter state. The filter toggle is a `div[role="button"]` with `aria-pressed` but it's missing `aria-label`. NVDA reads "button" only. We should add a visible label or `aria-label="Filter: experimental"` dynamically.

jamie: Good catch. For the focus clipping we can remove overflow hidden or add `padding` to parent. What about keyboard order? Tabbing goes search -> avatar -> global help, skipping action pills.

elaine: Tabindex order is wrong because .actions is visually after search but sits earlier in DOM. Quick fix: reorder DOM to match visual order or add `tabindex="0"` on pills but that's brittle.

kevin: reordering DOM is best. Also let's add `role="toolbar" aria-label="Top actions"` on the container so SR users get context.

maria: For contrast I measured the pill text against background: 2.9:1. Need 4.5:1 for normal text. Options: darken text or lighten pill bg. Darkening text is safer for theming.

axe-bot: Automated scan: 3 failures found — color-contrast (2), focus-visible (1). Details: /app/components/topbar/*

jamie: Plan: 1) reorder DOM to match visual layout (kevin), 2) add outline+outline-offset on focus + remove overflow clipping (elaine), 3) update aria-labels and role on pills (maria), 4) bump contrast token variable `--pill-text` (design). I'll file a tiny PR and tag y'all.

kevin: I'll take the PR review. If anyone wants to pair on reordering DOM let me know. :thumbsup: 

maria: I'll add unit tests for a11y: role/aria checks + axe in CI.

jamie: thanks — small follow-ups: add a note in the changelog about SR announcement change and include screenshot diff for contrast.

elaine: tagging @design for token change. 

jamie: <link to screenshot> https://redwood-internal.screenshots/topbar-focus-issue.png

kevin: quick CSS snippet I prototyped:
``
.toolbar-group { overflow: visible; }
.pill:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
```

maria: also update component docs to show keyboard nav example and mention `role=toolbar`.

jamie: awesome — closing this thread after PR lands. :rocket:
